title: Touhou Hisoutensoku ~ Choudokyuu Ginyoru no Nazo o Oe - Goddess of the Wind ~ Faith is for the Transient (Remix)
description:
𝓣𝓻𝓾𝓵𝔂, 𝓪𝓷𝔂𝔀𝓱𝓮𝓻𝓮 𝓘 𝓰𝓸, 𝓽𝓱𝓮𝓻𝓮 𝓪𝓵𝔀𝓪𝔂𝓼 𝓼𝓮𝓮𝓶𝓼 𝓽𝓸 𝓫𝓮 𝓼𝓸𝓶𝓮𝓸𝓷𝓮 𝔀𝓪𝓷𝓽𝓲𝓷𝓰 𝓽𝓸 𝓯𝓲𝓰𝓱𝓽. 𝓔𝓿𝓮𝓻𝔂𝓸𝓷𝓮 𝓲𝓷 𝓖𝓮𝓷𝓼𝓸𝓴𝔂𝓸 𝓼𝓮𝓮𝓶𝓼 𝓼𝓸 𝓻𝓸𝓾𝓰𝓱.

Did a special remix of Faith is for the Transient from Touhou 12.3: Hisoutensoku (for a 500 subscriber special). I had to do it given that Sanae Kochiya is (currently, as of this post description) my favorite Touhou character, and her theme song is one of my favorites. It's such an incredibly catchy and memorable theme song that's very fitting for her, and the Hisoutensoku version is perfect.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also 4 customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. B Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. C# Minor (Mountain of Faith Pitch)
3. A# Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
4. C Minor (Custom Pitch 2)
